summary.headline: Lunar Counters and Astronomical Instrument
summary.text: Lunar numerical tables explain counters, additions, and four “bricks” for days 1–30, followed by descriptions of an above-ground astronomical instrument with four large and eight small circles. Achilles and Hector appear in an example involving 29, 21, and one below-ground position; a footnote cites Riess and codex Neapolitanus 19 for the related tables.
